title: "Calculator: Confidence intervals with normal distribution"
author: Millie Harris
format: html
abstract-title: Summary
abstract: A calculator to provide confidence intervals, provided your data is normally distributed.
filters: 
  - shinylive
---

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
library("webexercises")
```

## Confidence interval calculator

```{=html}


<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Confidence interval calculator</title>

<style>
  .ci-app {
    --ci-blue: #3f68b6;
    --ci-orange: #db4315;
    --ci-light-blue: rgba(63,104,182,0.20);
    --ci-light-orange: rgba(219,67,21,0.25);
    color: #30343b;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .ci-app * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-title {
    background: var(--ci-blue);
    color: white;
    padding: 17px 20px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    font-size: 1.45rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.8fr);
    gap: 20px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-card {
    background: white;
    border: 1px solid #dedede;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-card-header {
    background: var(--ci-blue);
    color: white;
    padding: 13px 17px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-card-body {
    padding: 18px;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-control {
    margin-bottom: 22px;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-control:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  .ci-app label {
    display: block;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .ci-app input[type="number"] {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 9px 10px;
    border: 1px solid #c9cdd3;
    border-radius: 5px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #30343b;
  }

  .ci-app input[type="number"]::-webkit-inner-spin-button,
  .ci-app input[type="number"]::-webkit-outer-spin-button {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .ci-app input[type="number"] {
    -moz-appearance: textfield;
    appearance: textfield;
  }

  .ci-app input[type="range"] {
    width: 100%;
    accent-color: var(--ci-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-range-values {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    color: #6b7280;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-current-value {
    color: var(--ci-blue);
    font-weight: 700;
    float: right;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-plot-wrap {
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
  }

  .ci-app canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 490px;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-summary {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-result {
    background: #f5f7fb;
    border-left: 4px solid var(--ci-blue);
    border-radius: 5px;
    padding: 13px 15px;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-result-label {
    color: #555e6b;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-result-value {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--ci-blue);
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-explanation {
    margin-top: 15px;
    color: #606975;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .ci-app .ci-formula {
    background: #f5f7fb;
    padding: 12px 15px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    margin-top: 15px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
  }

  @media (max-width: 950px) {
    .ci-app .ci-layout {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }

    .ci-app canvas {
      height: 400px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .ci-app .ci-card-body {
      padding: 13px;
    }

    .ci-app .ci-summary {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }

    .ci-app canvas {
      height: 340px;
    }

    .ci-app .ci-title {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
  }
</style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="ci-app">

  <div class="ci-title">Confidence interval calculator</div>

  <div class="ci-layout">

    <!-- INPUTS -->
    <div class="ci-card">
      <div class="ci-card-header">Calculator inputs</div>

      <div class="ci-card-body">

        <div class="ci-control">
          <label for="ci-alpha">
            Significance level (α)
            <span class="ci-current-value" id="ci-alpha-value">0.05</span>
          </label>

          <input
            type="range"
            id="ci-alpha"
            min="0.01"
            max="0.20"
            value="0.05"
            step="0.01"
          >

          <div class="ci-range-values">
            <span>0.01</span>
            <span>0.20</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <hr>

        <div class="ci-control">
          <label for="ci-xbar">Sample mean (x̄)</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="ci-xbar"
            value="75"
            min="50"
            max="100"
            step="0.1"
          >
        </div>

        <div class="ci-control">
          <label for="ci-sigma">Sample standard deviation (s)</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="ci-sigma"
            value="10"
            min="1"
            max="20"
            step="0.1"
          >
        </div>

        <div class="ci-control">
          <label for="ci-n">Sample size (n)</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="ci-n"
            value="100"
            min="10"
            max="500"
            step="1"
          >
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PLOT -->
    <div class="ci-card">
      <div class="ci-card-header">
        Normal distribution and confidence interval
      </div>

      <div class="ci-card-body">
        <div class="ci-plot-wrap">
          <canvas
            id="ci-plot"
            role="img"
            aria-label="Standard normal distribution showing the confidence region and two rejection regions."
          ></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- SUMMARY -->
  <div class="ci-card">
    <div class="ci-card-header">Confidence interval summary</div>

    <div class="ci-card-body">

      <div class="ci-summary">

        <div class="ci-result">
          <div class="ci-result-label">Confidence level</div>
          <div class="ci-result-value" id="ci-confidence">95.0%</div>
        </div>

        <div class="ci-result">
          <div class="ci-result-label">Confidence interval</div>
          <div class="ci-result-value" id="ci-interval">[73.040, 76.960]</div>
        </div>

        <div class="ci-result">
          <div class="ci-result-label">Margin of error (ME)</div>
          <div class="ci-result-value" id="ci-me">1.960</div>
        </div>

        <div class="ci-result">
          <div class="ci-result-label">Standard error (SE)</div>
          <div class="ci-result-value" id="ci-se">1.000</div>
        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="ci-explanation">
        The confidence interval estimates the population mean (μ).
        The central blue region represents the confidence level, while
        the orange tails represent the two rejection regions, each with
        area α/2.
      </div>

      <div class="ci-formula">
        <strong>Confidence interval:</strong>
        x̄ ± Z<sub>α/2</sub> × SE
        <br>
        <strong>Standard error:</strong>
        SE = s / √n
        <br>
        <strong>Margin of error:</strong>
        ME = Z<sub>α/2</sub> × SE
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const app = document.querySelector(".ci-app");

  const alphaInput = app.querySelector("#ci-alpha");
  const xbarInput = app.querySelector("#ci-xbar");
  const sigmaInput = app.querySelector("#ci-sigma");
  const nInput = app.querySelector("#ci-n");

  const canvas = app.querySelector("#ci-plot");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  const BLUE = "#3f68b6";
  const ORANGE = "#db4315";
  const TEXT = "#30343b";
  const MUTED = "#6b7280";

  // Standard normal quantile using the Acklam approximation.
  function normalQuantile(p) {
    const a = [
      -3.969683028665376e+1,
       2.209460984245205e+2,
      -2.759285104469687e+2,
       1.383577518672690e+2,
      -3.066479806614716e+1,
       2.506628277459239
    ];

    const b = [
      -5.447609879822406e+1,
       1.615858368580409e+2,
      -1.556989798598866e+2,
       6.680131188771972e+1,
      -1.328068155288572e+1
    ];

    const c = [
      -7.784894002430293e-3,
      -3.223964580411365e-1,
      -2.400758277161838,
      -2.549732539343734,
       4.374664141464968,
       2.938163982698783
    ];

    const d = [
       7.784695709041462e-3,
       3.224671290700398e-1,
       2.445134137142996,
       3.754408661907416
    ];

    const low = 0.02425;
    const high = 1 - low;

    if (p <= 0 || p >= 1) {
      return NaN;
    }

    let q, r;

    if (p < low) {
      q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(p));

      return (((((c[0]*q+c[1])*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5]) /
        ((((d[0]*q+d[1])*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+1);
    }

    if (p > high) {
      q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1-p));

      return -(((((c[0]*q+c[1])*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5]) /
        ((((d[0]*q+d[1])*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+1);
    }

    q = p - 0.5;
    r = q * q;

    return (((((a[0]*r+a[1])*r+a[2])*r+a[3])*r+a[4])*r+a[5])*q /
      (((((b[0]*r+b[1])*r+b[2])*r+b[3])*r+b[4])*r+1);
  }

  function normalDensity(x) {
    return Math.exp(-0.5 * x * x) / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI);
  }

  function readNumber(input, fallback, min, max) {
    let value = Number(input.value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
      value = fallback;
    }

    value = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
    input.value = value;

    return value;
  }

  function calculate() {
    const alpha = Number(alphaInput.value);
    const xbar = readNumber(xbarInput, 75, 50, 100);
    const sigma = readNumber(sigmaInput, 10, 1, 20);
    const n = readNumber(nInput, 100, 10, 500);

    const confidence = (1 - alpha) * 100;
    const alphaHalf = alpha / 2;

    const zCritical = normalQuantile(1 - alphaHalf);
    const standardError = sigma / Math.sqrt(n);
    const marginOfError = zCritical * standardError;

    const lower = xbar - marginOfError;
    const upper = xbar + marginOfError;

    document.getElementById("ci-alpha-value").textContent =
      alpha.toFixed(2);

    document.getElementById("ci-confidence").textContent =
      confidence.toFixed(1) + "%";

    document.getElementById("ci-interval").textContent =
      "[" + lower.toFixed(3) + ", " + upper.toFixed(3) + "]";

    document.getElementById("ci-me").textContent =
      marginOfError.toFixed(3);

    document.getElementById("ci-se").textContent =
      standardError.toFixed(3);

    drawPlot({
      alpha,
      alphaHalf,
      confidence,
      zCritical,
      lower,
      upper
    });
  }

  function drawPlot(values) {
    const {
      alphaHalf,
      confidence,
      zCritical,
      lower,
      upper
    } = values;

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = Math.max(300, rect.width);
    const height = Math.max(300, rect.height);

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

    canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const margin = {
      top: 65,
      right: 35,
      bottom: 65,
      left: 55
    };

    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;

    const xMin = -4;
    const xMax = 4;
    const yMin = 0;
    const yMax = 0.5;

    function xPixel(x) {
      return margin.left + (x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin) * plotWidth;
    }

    function yPixel(y) {
      return margin.top + plotHeight -
        (y - yMin) / (yMax - yMin) * plotHeight;
    }

    // Background
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Confidence region
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xPixel(-zCritical), yPixel(0));

    for (let x = -zCritical; x <= zCritical; x += 0.01) {
      ctx.lineTo(xPixel(x), yPixel(normalDensity(x)));
    }

    ctx.lineTo(xPixel(zCritical), yPixel(0));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(63,104,182,0.20)";
    ctx.fill();

    // Left rejection region
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xPixel(xMin), yPixel(0));

    for (let x = xMin; x <= -zCritical; x += 0.01) {
      ctx.lineTo(xPixel(x), yPixel(normalDensity(x)));
    }

    ctx.lineTo(xPixel(-zCritical), yPixel(0));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(219,67,21,0.25)";
    ctx.fill();

    // Right rejection region
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xPixel(zCritical), yPixel(0));

    for (let x = zCritical; x <= xMax; x += 0.01) {
      ctx.lineTo(xPixel(x), yPixel(normalDensity(x)));
    }

    ctx.lineTo(xPixel(xMax), yPixel(0));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(219,67,21,0.25)";
    ctx.fill();

    // Normal curve
    ctx.beginPath();

    for (let i = 0; i <= 800; i++) {
      const x = xMin + (xMax - xMin) * i / 800;
      const y = normalDensity(x);

      if (i === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(xPixel(x), yPixel(y));
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(xPixel(x), yPixel(y));
      }
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = BLUE;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#555";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(margin.left, yPixel(0));
    ctx.lineTo(width - margin.right, yPixel(0));
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(margin.left, margin.top);
    ctx.lineTo(margin.left, yPixel(0));
    ctx.stroke();

    // X-axis ticks
    ctx.fillStyle = MUTED;
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

    for (let x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
      const px = xPixel(x);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(px, yPixel(0));
      ctx.lineTo(px, yPixel(0) + 5);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#777";
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillText(x.toString(), px, yPixel(0) + 20);
    }

    // Y-axis ticks
    ctx.textAlign = "right";

    for (let y = 0; y <= 0.5; y += 0.1) {
      const py = yPixel(y);

      ctx.fillText(y.toFixed(1), margin.left - 9, py + 4);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#eeeeee";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(margin.left, py);
      ctx.lineTo(width - margin.right, py);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Critical value lines
    [-zCritical, zCritical].forEach(z => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
      ctx.moveTo(xPixel(z), margin.top);
      ctx.lineTo(xPixel(z), yPixel(0));
      ctx.strokeStyle = ORANGE;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    });

    // Centre line
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xPixel(0), margin.top);
    ctx.lineTo(xPixel(0), yPixel(0));
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#30343b";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Critical value labels
    ctx.fillStyle = ORANGE;
    ctx.font = "bold 12px Arial";

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("-Z = " + (-zCritical).toFixed(3),
      xPixel(-zCritical) - 7, margin.top + 17);

    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("Z = " + zCritical.toFixed(3),
      xPixel(zCritical) + 7, margin.top + 17);

    // Confidence label
    ctx.fillStyle = BLUE;
    ctx.font = "bold 15px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(confidence.toFixed(1) + "% confidence",
      xPixel(0), yPixel(0.44));

    // Alpha labels
    ctx.fillStyle = ORANGE;
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

    ctx.fillText("α/2 = " + alphaHalf.toFixed(4),
      xPixel(-3), yPixel(0.07));

    ctx.fillText("α/2 = " + alphaHalf.toFixed(4),
      xPixel(3), yPixel(0.07));

    // Axis titles
    ctx.fillStyle = TEXT;
    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

    ctx.fillText("Z-score",
      margin.left + plotWidth / 2, height - 13);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(16, margin.top + plotHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillText("Probability density", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    // Plot title and interval subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = TEXT;
    ctx.font = "bold 15px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

    ctx.fillText("Standard normal distribution for confidence interval",
      width / 2, 23);

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = MUTED;

    ctx.fillText(
      "Confidence interval for μ: [" +
      lower.toFixed(2) + ", " + upper.toFixed(2) + "]",
      width / 2,
      43
    );
  }

  // Update when inputs change
  [alphaInput, xbarInput, sigmaInput, nInput].forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener("input", calculate);
    input.addEventListener("change", calculate);
  });

  // Redraw when the chart changes size
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => calculate());
    observer.observe(canvas);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("resize", calculate);
  }

  calculate();

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>



```
